arms.bcl@er_<key>: the same with experience replay (half of each batch from earlier demos)
arms.bcl@joint_<key>: one LoRA per step key trained on all the key's demos at once (b_continual.py; 2000 steps)
arms.bcl@seq_<key>: one LoRA per key fine-tuned task after task in the stream order (500 steps per task)
arms.lora: per-task one-demo LoRA, rank 16 (r3_fewshot.py; 18.7 MB per task, a demo for every task)

metrics.descriptive: two-sided sign tests and bootstrap intervals of c2_kept against lora, bcl joint, bcl seq, bcl er; seq against lora on each key's earlier arrivals (forgetting); costs per method: demonstrations used, bytes stored, practice episodes run before test
metrics.episodes: 20 per task and arm, fresh states 0-19, experiment f1_main

hypotheses.H1: C2 set: c2_kept > zs pooled (exact sign test on discordant pairs by state)

sets.C2: the 30 arrivals of c2_stream (4 step keys)
